caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden box with dovetail joints at its corners. The box is rendered in various shades of warm brown and yellow, highlighting the wood grain and texture. It has a flat lid with a slightly overhanging edge, and a small, circular keyhole with a dark metal escutcheon centered on the front side. The lower section of the box features a thicker base, with the wood grain on the base running horizontally. The box is set against a plain, off-white background. The artist's signature, "Frank H. Gray," is visible in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Strong Box
